choose.when: SELECT ACCESS_DEVICE_ID AS "accessDeviceId", NOISE AS "noise", TEMP AS "temp", HUMID AS "humid", TSP AS "tsp", TO_CHAR(RECORD_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "recordTime" FROM ${tableName} WHERE ACCESS_DEVICE_ID = #{deviceId} AND IS_DELETE = 0 AND RECORD_TIME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ENVIRONMENTAL_RECORD_ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
choose.otherwise: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ACCESS_DEVICE_ID AS "accessDeviceId", NOISE AS "noise", TEMP AS "temp", HUMID AS "humid", TSP AS "tsp", RECORD_TIME AS "recordTimeRaw", TO_CHAR(RECORD_TIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "recordTime" FROM ${tableName} WHERE ACCESS_DEVICE_ID = #{deviceId} AND IS_DELETE = 0 AND RECORD_TIME IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ENVIRONMENTAL_RECORD_ID DESC FETCH FIRST ${limit} ROWS ONLY ) T ORDER BY T."recordTimeRaw" DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
